title: Encoding and Parser Discrepancies in JSON and URLs
platform_conditions: Go 1.x standard library (encoding/json, net/url, net/http); applies to all build targets
security_mechanism: encoding/json matches struct field names case-insensitively when the exact name is absent, so a payload key 'isadmin' populates a field declared as isAdmin — an authorization field the API contract never exposed. Duplicate JSON keys are resolved last-wins with no error, and unknown fields are silently ignored, letting an attacker add privileged fields that a strict decoder would reject. Decoding into interface{} turns every number into float64, so 64-bit IDs above 2^53 lose precision and can collide with another resource's identifier. On the URL side, net/url parses and normalizes differently from browsers and proxies (percent-encoding, backslashes, embedded control characters), and http.Client follows redirects by default, so an allowlist checked on the first request is not enforced on the destination.

source_sink_clues.source: JSON request bodies, upstream API responses parsed into interface{}, and URLs from clients that pass through redirects or proxies.
source_sink_clues.sink: json.Unmarshal into structs holding security-relevant fields (roles/flags) without DisallowUnknownFields; numeric IDs decoded via interface{} into float64; authorization decisions on net/url-parsed values; http.Client requests that follow redirects from untrusted responses

tracking_guards: Require json.Decoder with DisallowUnknownFields for payloads feeding authorization decisions, and case-sensitive field handling (renamed fields or explicit checks) for privilege-bearing names; require int64/json.Number decoding for 64-bit IDs; require redirect policy that re-applies the host allowlist per hop (CheckRedirect returning an error).
not_candidate_when: The struct carries no privilege-relevant fields or unknown fields are rejected, IDs decode as exact-width integers (json.Number/int64), the redirect policy re-validates every hop, or the parsed URL host matches a fixed allowlist after canonicalization on each redirect target.
public_references: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/601.html
